description: A share of a 2-of-3 Pedersen dealing sealed to a holder, and the release of that share for a recovering device. The envelope is deterministic CBOR (see wire-format.md). Open it with the holder's seeds and the customer's vault-sign public key; changes in refuse must each be refused with the error named. The statement, the signature, the share and the commitments are also given in clear, for checks that have no HPKE.

refuse.name: a changed signature
refuse.why: the signature covers every other field

refuse.name: an unknown field in place of epoch
an unknown field in place of commit
another holder expected
refuse.why: a holder opens only the envelope made for its own id

refuse.name: a vault-sign key that is not the customer's

release.description: The recovering device holds a temporary key (its seed is here) and shows the code. The holder opens its share and seals it again, together with the signed share envelope. Open: the outer HPKE layer with the temporary key, then the inner layer with the key from the code. The inner item is CBOR { share, commitments, envelope }. The result is the share and the commitments of the dealing above, and the envelope must verify with the vault-sign public key above for the epoch above, name the same customer, holder and index, and carry the hash of those commitments. Opening is checked by the holder package's own test. Each entry of refuse gives a release and the inputs to open it with (the recovery id, the code, the customer, the vault-sign public key and the share epoch); it must be refused with the error named: code_mismatch when the release does not open, release_not_proven when it opens but the envelope inside does not prove the dealing.

refuse.name: a wrong code
refuse.why: the inner layer opens only with the code the customer told the holder

refuse.name: a wrong recovery id
refuse.why: the recovery id is part of the info and of the key

refuse.name: a wrong customer
refuse.why: the customer id is part of the info

refuse.name: a holder id changed in the release
refuse.why: the holder id is part of the info

refuse.name: an envelope that names another holder
refuse.why: the release opens, but the signed envelope inside is for a different holder

refuse.name: another share epoch expected
refuse.why: the envelope must be for the epoch the recovery started from

refuse.name: a vault-sign key that is not the customer's
refuse.why: the envelope must verify with the key the vault states

refuse.name: no envelope in the release
refuse.why: a release without the signed envelope is refused
